panels.description: Site 6 worksite. Tomas approaches Alex with the heavy old key while Ada studies the paper map. Leave upper worksite space.
Tomas holds the key and Alex's band shows the separate forty-credit note. Leave upper space.
Alex's band displays the overdue installment and restricted rail status. Leave display unobstructed.
A hauling frame collapses behind them and pins Tomas. Alex turns toward the impact. Leave upper machinery space.
